About the Author

Vignesh V Nayak

Vignesh V Nayak is a finance professional with over a decade of industry experience, a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, and a Certified NLP Practitioner and Life Coach.

Driven by a passion for continuous learning and personal growth, Vignesh believes that challenges are not merely obstacles to overcome, but valuable opportunities for transformation. His professional journey and personal experiences have shaped his belief in the importance of self-awareness, resilience, mindful leadership, and purposeful living.

What began as a journey of personal reflection gradually evolved into a deeper commitment to helping others navigate the complexities of modern corporate life. Through his writing, Vignesh encourages professionals to pause, reflect, realign their priorities, and rediscover clarity and purpose amid the demands of their careers.

Beyond his professional pursuits, Vignesh is an active Toastmasters member with a keen interest in mentoring, technology, and empowering early-career professionals.

The Book

Corporate Sanyasi

Corporate Sanyasi brings together Vignesh’s reflections into practical life and leadership lessons. Written for professionals who aspire to grow, lead, and succeed without compromising their values, the book encourages readers to pursue professional success while remaining connected to their personal values and inner well-being.

It is a reminder that true success is not measured by professional achievements alone, but also by the integrity, awareness, and purpose with which we pursue them.

  • Pursue success without compromising your values
  • Grow from feedback, not just collect it
  • Lead with self-awareness and resilience
  • Connect professional ambition with inner well-being
